Upstream README/NOTES provide general references, not per-match original-source citations. CC0 applies to the affirmer's rights and gives no third-party-rights or accuracy warranty. No club crest/trademark rights are granted by this data licence.
view: Retrospective corrected end of played calendar date. Not known-then, intraday, live or original-schedule replay. Kickoff strings have no explicit timezone and are not used.
adjustments: Results-only calculation. No point deductions/adjustments are supplied or invented; generic adjustment support is not implemented. Checked terminal leader totals agree with primary league reports, not an exhaustive audit of every result/date.

rule_sources.rules: League-authored handbooks filed as Manchester United exhibits: C.2 three/one points; C.4-C.6 points, goal difference, goals scored; C.7 shared position; C.17 neutral deciding matches if final title/relegation/qualification unresolved. Alphabetical display is not a sporting tiebreak. No modern head-to-head rule applied.

excluded: No football-data.co.uk files fetched. footballcsv/england not adopted: its NOTES trace to jalapic/engsoccerdata whose source list includes football-data.co.uk. StatsBomb not used.
